[EN] I'm worried about the apprentices. Craxan took them to Frostclaw Crag—that's no place for a beginner.
[ES] Me preocupan los aprendices. Craxan se los llevó a Frostclaw Crag; ese no es lugar para un principiante.

[EN] I'm glad to hear they're all right. Thank you.
[ES] Me alegra saber que están bien. Gracias.

[EN] Craxan's a fool, but a devoted father. Hard to fault an aman for that.
[ES] Craxan es un tonto, pero un padre devoto. Es difícil reprocharle eso a un aman.

[EN] That fool thinks he has two lives!
[ES] ¡Ese tonto cree que tiene dos vidas!

[EN] I'll strangle him myself!
[ES] ¡Lo estrangularé yo mismo!
